steps: Build two WAVs from tests/fixtures/sample.wav by appending a LIST/INFO chunk: nul-comment.wav with ICMT size 1 payload 00 (+ ISFT 'Recorder 1.0\0'), nul-title.wav with INAM size 2 payload 00 00 (python generator in c-round-5.md, C-R5-01)
ffprobe -show_entries format_tags -of json shows comment="" / title="" (empty)
Open the folder in the built app (xvfb-run, _electron, c-round-5/probe-nul.mjs)
bugs.expected: Under the intent of D-15 a file with no visible value should not be 'Tagged' (ffprobe, the backend's reader, sees only empty strings)
bugs.actual: Both rows show 'Tagged'. meta:read keeps the NUL terminator (the Comment field of an ffmpeg-written ICMT also shows 'მძიმე კარი\u0000'), and String.prototype.trim() does not strip \u0000, so hasAnyTagValue counts it. Not covered by the D-15 text in current-task.md (empty = '', whitespace, [], 0, non-finite), so this is an edge outside this round's acceptance, not a FAIL of A's work. Fix belongs either to the reader (strip trailing NULs in metadata.ts, frozen this round) or to hasAnyTagValue (treat \0 as blank) - B to decide.
bugs.evidence: c-round-5/r5-x-nul.log (nul-comment.wav tagged=1, nul-title.wav tagged=1), c-round-5/r5-x-nul-comment.png, c-round-5/r5-result.json commentOnlyPanel.comment = 'მძიმე კარი\u0000'

steps: ffmpeg -i tests/fixtures/sample.wav -metadata comment='მძიმე კარი' -c copy comment-only.wav (writes ICMT NUL-terminated, 29 bytes)
Open the folder in the built app, click comment-only.wav, read the Comment input value (c-round-5/drive-r5b.mjs)
bugs.expected: Comment field value 'მძიმე კარი' (ffprobe shows exactly that)
bugs.actual: Comment input value is 'მძიმე კარი\u0000': meta:read (src/main/ipc/metadata.ts, frozen this round) keeps the RIFF INFO NUL terminator. Affects any INFO field written by ffmpeg or recorders; a later save would likely write the NUL back as data. Pre-existing, not introduced by round 5; root cause of C-R5-01. Not in the open-findings list.
